questions.question: A train is running at a speed of 99 km/h. If the train is 565 m long, then what will be the time (in seconds) taken by it to cross a 975 m long tunnel?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total distance to cross = 565 + 975 = 1540 m

Speed of the train = 99 km/h = 99 × 5/18 = 55/2 m/s

Time taken = Total Distance ÷ Speed = 1540 ÷ (55/2) = 56 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 56 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of the train = 565 m

Length of the tunnel = 975 m

Speed of the train = 99 km/h

**Formula Used:**

Time = Total Distance ÷ Speed

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = Length of Train + Length of Tunnel

⇒ Total Distance = 565 + 975 = 1540 m

⇒ Speed of the train in m/s = 99 × 5/18

⇒ Speed = 11 × 5/2 = 55/2 m/s

⇒ Time taken = Total Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Time = 1540 ÷ (55/2)

⇒ Time = (1540 × 2) ÷ 55

⇒ Time = 28 × 2 = 56 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 56 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed Conversion

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert from m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Crossing an Object with Length

When a train crosses a platform, bridge, or tunnel, the total distance covered is the sum of the length of the train and the length of the object being crossed.

Crossing a Point Object

When a train crosses a stationary man, pole, or tree, the total distance covered is equal to the length of the train alone.

Relative Speed

If two trains move in opposite directions, their relative speed is S₁ + S₂. If they move in the same direction, it is S₁ − S₂.

questions.question: If the nine-digit number 87605x31y is divisible by 72, then the value of 2x - 3y is:
questions.solution:
**Given: **

985x3678y is divisible by 72,

**Concept used:**

A number will be divisible by 8 if the last 3 digit of a number is divisible by 8.

A number will be divisible by 9 if the sum of the digits is divisible by 9.

**Calculation:**

A number will be divisible by 8 if the last 3 digit of a number is divisible by 8.

⇒ 31y will be divisible by 8 if and only if y = 2

So, the number becomes 87605x312

Now, The sum of digits is (32 + x)

The number will be divisible by 9 if the sum of the digits is divisible by 9.

For this x must be 4 [x is a digit, x can't be 13]

⇒ x = 4

Now, We have to find the value of 2x – 3y

⇒ 2 × 4 – 3 × 2 = 2

**∴ Required answer is 2**

questions.question: One side of a rectangular field is 39 m and its diagonal is 89 m. What is the area of the field?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

One side of rectangular field = 39 m

Diagonal = 89 m 

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = Length × breadth

Pythagoras theorem,

Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e620ec570ee4224d8452aee2bd38b1e6d25bc54aaf73912dd9184afaabaf0a.png] **

According to the figure,

by Pythagoras theorem,

BD² = AB² + AD²

⇒ 89² – 39² = AD²

⇒ AD² = 7921 - 1521 = 6400 

⇒ AD = 80 m

Area = Length × breadth

⇒ A = 39 m × 80 m

⇒ A = 3120 m²

**∴ The area of the field is 3120 m2**

The ratio of two numbers = 9 : 7

According to the question,

⇒ 9x - x = 56 

⇒ 8x = 56

The sum of two numbers = 9 × 7 + 7 × 7

**∴ The sum of the two numbers is 112 **

questions.question: A can do a piece of work in 12 days. He worked for 6 days and left, and then B finished it in 10 days. If both work together, then in how many days will they finish the same work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**A** completes 1/2 work in **6 days** (half of 12 days).

**B** finishes the remaining 1/2 work in **10 days**, so **B** takes 20 days for full work.

Together Time = (A × B) ÷ (A + B) = (12 × 20) ÷ (12 + 20)

Together Time = 240 ÷ 32 = 7.5 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **A** = 12 days

Work done by **A** in 6 days = 6 ÷ 12 = 1/2

Remaining work = 1 − 1/2 = 1/2

Time taken by **B** to finish 1/2 work = 10 days

⇒ Time taken by **B** to finish full work = 10 × 2 = 20 days

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 **A**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Efficiency of (A + B) = 5 + 3 = 8 units/day

⇒ Total Work = 60 units

⇒ Time taken by (A + B) together = Total Work ÷ Total Efficiency

⇒ Time = 60 ÷ 8

⇒ Time = 7.5 days

**∴ The correct answer is 7.5 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken. If a person takes **n** days to complete a work, their 1-day efficiency is 1/n.

Combined Work Formula

For two people with individual completion times **x** and **y**, the time taken together is (x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Work done by different efficiencies

Total Work = Σ(Efficiency × Time). This concept is useful when people leave or join work midway.</p

questions.question: A ladder 10 m long rests against a vertical wall making an angle of 30° with the wall. How high up (in m) does it reach the wall from the ground? (Take sqrt 3 = 1.73.)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **ladder** makes an angle θ with a **vertical wall**, the height reached (h) is the **adjacent side** of the triangle.

Formula: **Height** = **Ladder Length** × cos(θ)

Height = 10 × cos(30°) = 10 × (√3 ÷ 2)

Height = 5 × 1.73 = 8.65 m

**∴ The correct answer is 8.65 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: **Ladder length** = 10 m, **Angle with wall** = 30°, √3 = 1.73.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcdb500b623781a331f22921d12c91c9dc6c2429256733cd6ae668c27cb9cff5.png] 

In the right-angled triangle **ABC**, let **AC** be the wall, **BC** be the ground, and **AB** be the ladder.

⇒ **Hypotenuse** (AB) = 10 m

⇒ **Angle** with wall (∠BAC) = 30°

⇒ cos(∠BAC) = Adjacent side (AC) ÷ Hypotenuse (AB)

⇒ cos(30°) = Height (h) ÷ 10

⇒ (√3 ÷ 2) = h ÷ 10

⇒ h = (10 × √3) ÷ 2

⇒ h = 5 × 1.73

⇒ h = 8.65 m

**∴ The correct answer is 8.65 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios

For a right-angled triangle, sin θ = opposite/hypotenuse and cos θ = adjacent/hypotenuse.

Angle with Ground vs Wall

If the angle with the wall is θ, the angle with the ground is (90° − θ). For θ = 30°, the angle with the ground is 60°.

Pythagoras Theorem

In any right triangle, (Base)² + (Height)² = (Hypotenuse)².

Common Trig Values

cos(30°) = √3/2 ≈ 0.866; sin(30°) = 1/2 = 0.5; tan(30°) = 1/√3 ≈ 0.577.</p

questions.question: Two numbers are less than a third number by 37% and 30%, respectively. By what percentage is the second number more than the first?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two numbers are less than third number by 37% and 30% respectively.

**Calculations:**

Let the third number(C) be '100'.

⇒ The first number(A) = (100 - 37)% of 100

⇒ A = 63

The second number(B) = (100 - 30)% of 100

⇒ B = 70 

Now, Percent by which B is more than by A is = {(70 - 63)/63} × 100

⇒ (100)/(9) 

**∴ The percentage by which the second number is more than the first is (100)/(9)%**
